access_law: Packages change active managed quantity, speed, monitoring intensity, human depth, SLA, escalation, manual fallback intensity, and reporting depth. Packages do not hide the core Kingsmen route brain or core safety capabilities.

packages.name: Foundational Accord
benefits: CAO support where applicable; one CAO parent application is one Kingsmen application
NSFAS, TVET, and SETA support where relevant
CV and motivation-letter support where a route requires it
Application ordering, proof tracking, candidate status visibility
Duplicate-submission prevention and intelligent document reuse
boundaries: No guaranteed admission, funding, employment, or accommodation
Routes depend on verified sources, eligibility, opening status, consent, and provider requirements
packages.summary: A controlled academic and opportunity campaign foundation.

packages.name: Collegiate Ordinance
benefits: Queue management and supported automatic release
Programme-fit scoring and institutional compatibility filtering
Deadline-aware timing, alternative recommendations, and fallback routes
boundaries: Matching is decision support, not an acceptance guarantee
Automated submission only where provider rules and verified integrations permit
packages.summary: Guided academic alignment and informed application progression.

packages.name: Chancellor's Writ
benefits: NSFAS and CAO execution support where applicable
Supported auto-submit when eligible opportunities open
Application-fee and institutional-pattern awareness where reliable data exists
Sequencing, timing, ranking, and multi-path fallback strategy
boundaries: Acceptance likelihoods are estimates, not promises
Monitoring and automated submissions require verified data and supported integrations
packages.summary: Strategic academic orchestration across multiple viable pathways.

packages.name: Regency Mandate
benefits: NSFAS and CAO support where applicable
Elite matching and intensive placement recovery strategy
Real-time opening/seat detection when reliable data supports it
Immediate supported execution when conditions are met
24-hour monitoring target subject to live coverage
Emergency fallback routes and institution-opening alerts
boundaries: No guarantee of provider response, seat, admission, or continuously available human operator
Live monitoring and escalation must be operationally verified
packages.summary: Highest package intensity for urgent, closely monitored placement campaigns.

packages.name: Artisan Charter
benefits: Employment, internship, learnership, apprenticeship, and artisan route support
boundaries: No guarantee of interview, offer, employment, or provider acceptance
CV and letter content must remain truthful
packages.summary: A practical entry into employment, internships, learnerships, apprenticeships, and artisan routes.

packages.name: Guildmaster's Charter
boundaries: ATS compatibility does not guarantee selection or interview
CV and letters must reflect candidate-provided evidence
packages.summary: Advanced professional positioning and career-path support.

packages.name: CV Revamp
benefits: Truthful personalisation based on candidate-provided evidence
boundaries: Must not invent experience, qualifications, references, certificates, skills, or results
packages.summary: Standalone personalised CV and motivation-letter preparation.

packages.name: Accommodation Support Package
packages.summary: Standalone accommodation-route assistance; zero managed education/employment applications.
benefits: Accommodation proof tracking and fallback options
boundaries: Kingsmen does not handle rent/deposits or guarantee accommodation
Routes depend on verification, availability, and consent

cv_revamp_upgrade_rule.applies_when: A user first pays R49.99 for CV Revamp and later upgrades to any Kingsmen package.
cv_revamp_upgrade_rule.benefit: +2 active managed applications/routes on top of the selected package's normal active-managed quantity.
cv_revamp_upgrade_rule.trust_reason: The initial CV Revamp purchase is not wasted and becomes part of the user's Kingsmen growth path.

accommodation_package_privilege.current_policy: Users who selected a Kingsmen package currently get accommodation support access at no extra accommodation-support charge where relevant.
accommodation_package_privilege.candidate_language: Accommodation support is a current package privilege, subject to verification, availability, consent, and no rent/payment handling by Kingsmen.

forbidden_prices_or_labels: Any package price not listed in this manifest unless explicitly changed by founder and validated

growth_cap.cap_limits: active managed volume, not core capability access

entitlement_contract.source_of_truth: package-catalogue.json plus canonical finance/service catalogue reconciliation migration
entitlement_contract.policy: Packages change managed quantity and service intensity, not dignity or core safety capabilities.
entitlement_contract.caO_counting_rule: One CAO parent application counts as one Kingsmen application; programme choices are children of that parent.
entitlement_contract.accommodation_policy: Each paid core Kingsmen package includes up to 8 ACC-01 routes where relevant. Accommodation Support standalone is R179.00, includes 8 accommodation routes, and includes zero managed education/employment applications.
entitlement_contract.status_note: Entitlements are product policy; production claims require working service paths and deployed runtime evidence.
entitlement_contract.runtime_status: Canonical source contract only until reviewed migration application, sandbox checkout/ITN, candidate isolation, and deployed E2E evidence are recorded.
